missing.reason: No redistributable copy of the BNBC 2020 text is held in the repo; the seismic-zone values used by the engine come from the rule pack's source registry entry, not from a clause corpus. Ingest after the BYO-PDF path (plan section 5.6) provides a lawful copy.
Appendix 5 (definitions) is not transcribed yet - pack candidates item C4. Terms such as open space and covered area therefore have no clause-level citation in v0.
City rule packs beyond RAJUK are P4 work; the pack registry lists them as pending, so the corpus covers Dhaka only and says so.

sources.notes: Clause documents are derived from the pack's provisions, tables, footnotes and declared gaps. Provision text is our summary of the provision (textKind pack_summary); only the footnotes are transcribed gazette wording (textKind gazette_quote).
